newsitem.title: USA: Filene's Basement names Carothers president.
newsitem.headline: Filene's Basement names Carothers president.

text.p: Filene's Basement Corp on Monday said W. Jay Carothers has been named president and chief operating officer to replace Mone Anathan III, who is commencing early retirement.
The company said Carothers was also named chief operating officer and was appointed to the board of directors.

The company said Anathan, who has led the company since 1983, will continue to maintain a presence at the company in a diminished role. Anathan said in a prepared statement he is planning to pursue business interests outside retailing, as well.
Carothers has an extensive background in the retail clothing industry, the company said.
